biography: Piet Sjoukes, Director Sales @NorthC datacenters With eleven data centers NorthC is the largest regional data center business in the Netherlands that serves both large organizations and government institutions as well as cloud and IT providers and small businesses. NorthC differentiates itself by their strong local presence in different regions, qualitative high-end services, and custom solutions when it comes to connectivity and hybrid cloud solutions, among other things. Thanks to close collaborations with regional IT partners, NorthC can offer complete solutions that help customers with their digital transformation. Together the ten locations have a surface area of 60.000 m2 and an electrical capacity of 35 megawatts Mr. Sjoukes previously worked for industry leaders such as: Interxion - Sales & Marketing Director (2016-2021); Akamai, Regional Sales Manager (2015- 2016); Ericsson, Sales Manager (2010-2015) Dutchview; (Sales Manager, 2005-2010); Cap Gemini (New Business development manager 1993 – 1999); WorldOnline (Director E-commerce, 1999 – 2001) and Sybase Inc. (Sales Manager, 2001 – 2005). Piet Sjoukes was also associated partner the CostFocus consultancy firm and above all ....a fanatic Wine lover & expert.
